title: p.apyr.us docs page: the cover image picker (stock images from Wikimedia Commons)
description: Document for editors on p.apyr.us: the Cover image button on a saved Story, four options, Accept, reload, search words, Give up; where the credit shows (under the picture on the article page only, never on cards or index pages); which licences are offered and which are not; that the picture is copied into the site's own storage; that saving makes the new Story version. Not written yet; per the rule that every feature epic ends with a docs task. Built in the PR for PPY-a36ac3 and PPY-956dff first step.
